muxt check

flags:
--allow-unused
  shorthand: ""
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "list templates nothing executes without failing; for templates rendered outside muxt"
--receiver-type
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: true
  deprecated: "muxt check reads the receiver type from the generated routes file and ignores this flag"
  usage: "DEPRECATED and ignored: muxt check reads the receiver type from the generated routes file."
--templates-variable
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: true
  deprecated: "use --use-templates-variable instead"
  usage: "DEPRECATED: use --use-templates-variable instead. the name of the global variable with type *\"html/template\".Template in the working directory package."
--use-templates-variable
  shorthand: ""
  type: stringSlice
  default: "[templates]"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "the name of the global variable with type *\"html/template\".Template in the working directory package."
--verbose
  shorthand: "v"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "verbose log output"

--help:
Type-checks each template against the data type at its `ExecuteTemplate` call site and reports templates nothing renders.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/check.md

Usage:
  muxt check [package-dir] [flags]

Aliases:
  check, c

Flags:
      --allow-unused                     list templates nothing executes without failing; for templates rendered outside muxt
  -h, --help                             help for check
      --use-templates-variable strings   the name of the global variable with type *"html/template".Template in the working directory package. (default [templates])
  -v, --verbose                          verbose log output

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
